title: How to Keep Your Kitchen Drain Flowing Smoothly
description: Preventing stubborn kitchen sink clogs starts with good daily habits. Never pour fats, oils, or grease down your drain, as they solidify inside waste pipes and trap food scraps. Always use a fine mesh strainer in your sink basin to catch solid particles before they enter the plumbing system. Periodically flush the drain with hot tap water to clear minor organic buildup. If drainage slows down, inspect the P-trap beneath the sink. Placing a small bucket underneath while carefully loosening the trap nut allows you to clean out trapped debris safely. For persistent backups deep in the line, consult a licensed plumber.
